purpose: External Gemma4 throughput comparison; llama.cpp was verified to identify the exported BF16 model as gemma4 E2B BF16.

runner.visible_device_check: llama-bench --list-devices reported one ROCm device: AMD Radeon Graphics, gfx1201, 32624 MiB. No V620 was visible.

model.scope_note: The GGUF is a text-model export, whereas the uLLM resident allocation deliberately includes the complete source safetensors payload (vision/audio tensors included). Throughput is comparable as a Gemma4 text-decoder reference; the two VRAM footprints are not asserted to be identical.

preflight.decision: accepted: service was not running and amd-smi reported no R9700 process before the timing run

accounting.prefill: Three prompt-processing repetitions, six prompt tokens each. llama-bench's reported average tokens/s is used; model load and no profiler range are included in neither result.
accounting.decode: Three token-generation repetitions with n_gen=4. llama-bench's reported average tokens/s is used; model load and no profiler range are included in neither result.
accounting.kv_dtype: F32 for K and V, chosen to match the resident executor's F32 device K/V cache.

telemetry.note: These are start/end amd-smi snapshots. The timing result is llama-bench's own wall-clock throughput, not an amd-smi or profiler-range duration.
